# Synthetic owner policy

No owner policy approval supplied. All rules are draft ArcKit proposals.

- D1: No current provider or community arrangement delivers required technical support and security fixes for the exact deployed version. Warning: Evidenced breach forecast within 12 calendar months.
- D2: Required operating rights or support obligations have lapsed without suitable continuity arrangements. Warning: Evidenced breach forecast within 12 calendar months.
- D3: Tested capability to operate, restore, patch or safely change the system is absent, including necessary cover for key people. Warning: Evidenced breach forecast within 12 calendar months.
- D4: An agreed user, statutory, performance or business requirement is demonstrably unmet without an acceptable workaround. Warning: Evidenced breach forecast within 12 calendar months.
- D5: Measured capacity, physical reliability, repairability or recovery fails the agreed operating requirement without verified mitigation. Warning: Evidenced breach forecast within 12 calendar months.
- D6: Persistent exploitable weaknesses breach the applicable CAF profile or Secure by Design requirements without verified adequate controls. Warning: Evidenced breach forecast within 12 calendar months.
- D7: Necessary operational reliance on an assessed Legacy service exceeds the owner tolerance documented for the consuming system. Warning: Evidenced breach forecast within 12 calendar months.
